final:
`Ledger.post` in `ledger/entries.py` now logs one INFO record on the `ledger` logger for each posted entry. The four existing tests pass. I didn't add a test for the new log line.

The record reads `posted entry account=<redacted id> amount=<Money>`. The amount uses `Money.__str__`, so it appears as a dollar string like `12.34`.

The account id goes through `redact()`, so only its last four characters show. The repo has a `# Rule:` comment in `ledger/log.py` saying never to log raw account ids. That conflicts with my saved notes, one of which says to log the raw id so support can grep by account. The code rule is the current one, so I followed it and did not change any rule.
